- **Time Complexity:** Allocation is $O(1)$ amortized due to power-of-2 growth, but reallocation is $O(N)$ where $N$ is the number of vertices.
- **Memory Complexity:** $O(N)$, where $N$ is the next power of 2 greater than or equal to the number of splats.
Power-of-2 allocation minimizes fragmentation and reallocation frequency.
Power-of-2 allocation can lead to memory waste if the vertex count is not a power of 2.
